verdict.line: You lose if you stand and trade near walls or let Test of Spirit tether you before level 6; you win once Feast and your item spikes let you poke her down with Q and W the way OP.GG's data says to.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's passive spawns Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain that swing at anyone caught near her Test of Spirit (E) spirit, and that spirit echoes a percentage of all damage it takes straight back onto Cho'Gath — so this lane is decided by whether Cho'Gath lets himself get tethered near a wall before level 6. Across 83 games Cho'Gath wins only 45.8% of this matchup, matching the measured lane and solo-kill advantage for Illaoi, because Cho'Gath has no point-blank answer before Feast (R) comes online. OP.GG's own read agrees: dodge E, poke with Q and W, and only commit once level 6 gives true damage.

theirWindow.when: Near walls or tethered by E, levels 1-5
theirWindow.what: Tentacles near walls swing at you and heal her on every champion hit, and if you stay near the spirit (E, 900 range, CD 16/15/14/13/12s) too long or damage it, that damage echoes onto you and you become a Vessel spawning Tentacles against yourself. Back off from walls and break the tether distance the moment she casts it.

yourWindow.when: Level 6+, after her E is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Lead with Q (Rupture, 9s CD, 950 range) to knock up and slow, land W (Feral Scream, 13s CD, 300 range) to silence her Harsh Lesson engage, then finish with R (Feast, 60s CD, 175 range) for true damage — a kill grows your max health (up to 6 stacks) and snowballs the next fight.

start.why: The standard start (75.4% pick, 43.5% WR over 92 games) — the mana and sustain let you spam Q (9s CD) and W (13s CD) to poke from range instead of trading autos into her tentacle-boosted damage.

boots.why: 53.5% pick, 44.3% WR — flattens the physical damage from her autos, Q tentacle smashes, and passive Tentacle swings that make up most of her early damage.

core.why: Gives you a gap-closer to punish her the instant Test of Spirit's tether breaks, stacked on top of magic burst.
Sustained damage and tankiness let you win extended fights once you've survived to your item spikes, matching your late power curve.
Health and move speed let you catch her after she over-commits with W (Harsh Lesson) without sacrificing durability.

you need an early grievous wounds component to cut her passive tentacle healing

runes.keystoneWhy: 50% WR on this page — Grasp pairs with Vorpal Spikes' on-attack damage to heal you through her early harassment, which matters since you're on the back foot until Feast comes online at 6.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is run in 63.6% of games (49.4% WR) because this is a scaling matchup — Flash lets you disengage her W leap or an E tether early, and Teleport resets you after losing a trade or brings you back once Feast and your core items make you the stronger champion from level 6 on.

playing.title: Never fight near walls
playing.detail: Her passive spawns Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain that swing and heal her on any champion hit — step away from walls before trading so tentacles can't add free damage and sustain to her side.

playing.title: Break Test of Spirit immediately
playing.detail: When she casts E (900 range, CD 16/15/14/13/12s), retreat far enough to break the tether or kill the spirit outright — any damage it takes echoes back onto you, and staying near it too long turns you into a Vessel spawning Tentacles against your own team.

playing.title: Poke, don't stand and trade
playing.detail: Lead with Q (9s CD, 950 range) to knock up and slow from range, then W (13s CD, 300 range) to silence her Harsh Lesson engage — this is the slow upper-hand play OP.GG flags, and it avoids letting her stack tentacle and Q damage on you.

playing.title: Save Feast for level 6
playing.detail: You have no execute before R (60s CD, 175 range), so don't commit to all-ins — once it's up, use it point-blank for true damage and to grow your max HP (up to 6 stacks) off a kill.

playing.title: Weave Vorpal Spikes between casts
playing.detail: E fires passively on every attack and hits everything in front of you for free (0.5s CD) — weave autos between Q and W during short trades since it costs nothing extra.

playing.title: Track her Q for tentacle spikes
playing.detail: Her Q (10/9/8/7/6s CD) increases tentacle damage when active — if it's down, tentacles near her hit harder, so disengage the moment she lands it.

playing.title: Use Teleport to avoid forced all-ins
playing.detail: Reset after losing a trade or soaking poke, then Teleport back once you've scaled past level 6 instead of forcing a fight early just to save CS.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, boots, runes, and summoners above are pulled from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the win rates, sample sizes, and pick rates are fact, but the tactical reasoning — avoiding walls, breaking Test of Spirit, timing Feast — is my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with (E). Use [Q][W] to slowly gain the upper hand in combat and kill her after reaching level 6.
